# this will also include the conflicted files
    tree_hash = cmd_output('git', 'write-tree')[1].strip()
    merge_diff_filenames = zsplit(
        cmd_output(
            'git', 'diff', '--name-only', '--no-ext-diff', '-z',
            '-m', tree_hash,
            # pull the refs in front of the `--` so they are unambiguously
            # revisions even if the worktree has a tracked file named HEAD
            'HEAD', 'MERGE_HEAD', '--',
        )[1],
    )
    return set(merge_conflict_filenames) | set(merge_diff_filenames)
